TBSdec is used in modding, to edit parameters of the game that are not "hard coded" in the game-files, but only stored in human-readable container files (JSON). When the game starts, it loads those JSON files and plays accordingly. So, for instance, you can: edit text in the dialogues, alter the flow of events, change how much Renown/Supplies you get from an event, modify battle boards/units/items, or tweak abilities.

This is an AIR-app installer. You must first install (or update) Adobe AIR on your system, and then double click on the file to install the app. Accept any "risks" involved with "unsafe" authors, expired certificates etc. Before this, uninstall any previous versions of TBSdec.

Once installed, open the app/program, point it to the game installation "assets" directory (e.g., for Saga1, it could be -- E:\myGames\SteamLibrary\SteamApps\common\tbs\assets), browse around and select a JSON.Z file to edit, from the navigation panel on the left. The main text-editor panel is activated on the right. Don't worry, on first edit TBSdec creates a backup of the original file (same name, *.orig extension).

This version of TBSdec has several improvements over the original, by Stoic's John Watson:
 1. Bypasses certificate issues that lead to a "damaged/corrupted" message on installation.
 2. Can open all (?) compressed text/data-container files (JSON.Z etc), from all three Saga games.
 3. Has a "Find" function to locate a string in the edited text-file, handy for huge files. 
 4. Can decompile/recompile entire folder-trees (in the assets directory). Handy if you prefer using another program for text-editing (e.g. notepad++), or simultaneously working on multiple files.
